dispatch: Reject new PM reservations, base/news runs, rehearsals, recoveries and paper entries at or after effective_from, including preflight. Historical runs before retirement retain their original authorization and registration checks.
monitoring: Remove only daily PM-run expectations and PM rehearsal retries. Keep AM gates and every order, lot, exit, reconciliation and label obligation, including historical PM predictions and intents.
sentinel: Ignore only the five exact PM-only services and four exact PM-only timers after retirement. Ignore MISSING_PM_RUN and FAILED_PM_RUN only when their alert timestamp is at or after effective_from; malformed or historical alerts remain actionable. Keep every other failure visible.
preserved: Original grants and identities, v1/v2 PM specs, preregistrations, journal bindings, registrations, collisions, budgets, historical scoring and lot exit horizons. No store rebind or implicit migration.
